Historical UP3 Round6 read-only captures, copied byte-for-byte from06be7c0.
These are real schema/layout examples, not PC1 hardware qualification.

production-serve-rank*.sh are actual mounted launchers (Docker Cmd ['/serve.sh'],
Entrypoint ['/bin/bash']). production-host-shapes.json projects each Docker
inspect and six sysfs reads. Env retains only EXL3_RDMA_DEVICES, not the full live
environment. Production logs retain selected startup/source-generated single-ring
lines; they do not prove all inherited readiness/capacity fields are present.
No PC1 test fabricates a successful CPU-pin/poller log.

The tests change only specific flags/fields for explicit negative cases or
registered experiment arms, preserving shell continuations and quoted JSON.
New PC1 live read-only observations are separately reported outside git.
